infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Leads Rubix uses the camera for uploading deal documents and lead attachments.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Leads Rubix uses the photo library for uploading lead attachments.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Leads Rubix uses the microphone for recording call logs and voice notes.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Leads Rubix requires access to contacts to allow users to select and attach contact details while creating a lead.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Leads Rubix uses your location to capture accurate site visit check-ins and lead coordinates.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Leads Rubix requires calendar access to synchronize scheduled client visits and tasks.
